title: Maternily
description: Offline-first WhatsApp agent that digitizes paper maternal health registries in low-resource settings into structured, midwife-verified records. Combines free local PaddleOCR and form templates with selective Claude AI fallback, handling uncertainty through interactive review conversations and linking multi-page visits to patient profiles. Enables midwives to continue working on paper without accounts or continuous signal, while clinic supervisors gain access to encrypted records, health analytics, and audit logs.
